fixture.note: 169 is the exact R11/R12b fixture; 1/16/64 take its first N entries; 1024 repeats the fixture with suffixed names and 4x4 float32 tensors

native_floor.floor_note: stat_file is the cheapest request/response the service offers; the marshalling and memfd write are the client work a native encoder cannot avoid. Rust encoding, the reply copy and the plan-less store lookup are excluded, so this is a strict lower bound.
